fields.claim_id: C001 - stable id, unique within the notes
fields.field: research_question | data | method_conditions | main_findings | conclusion | limitations
fields.anchor: S4 ¶1/L14 - section id, paragraph index and source line
fields.quote: the verbatim sentence from the paper that grounds the note

rules: anchor must point at the section and paragraph the quote was taken from
quote must be copied verbatim from the paper; a mismatch is reported verbatim=false, never passed as grounded
has_number is true only when the quoted sentence itself carries a numeric value
one JSON object per line, utf-8, no trailing commas, no placeholder values
